Evidence:
[1] Dust is the sixth solo studio album by English musician Peter Murphy.
[2] It was released on 23 April 2002 through Metropolis Records.
[3] He was the vocalist of the Goth rock group Bauhaus and later went on to release a number of solo albums, such as "Deep", "Holy Smoke", and "Love Hysteria".
[4] "Dust to Dust" found limited success, peaking at #171 on the "Billboard" 200, #50 on the Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums and #3 on the Top Heatseekers.
